subject: Password reset link not arriving
body: Hi, I requested a password reset for my account [EMAIL_1] three times today but the email never arrives. Can you help?

precedents.subject: Password reset link not arriving
precedents.answer_snippet: Reset emails can take up to 10 minutes to arrive and are often filtered as spam. Please check your spam or junk folder before requesting another link.

precedents.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
precedents.answer_snippet: After verifying the account owner, we triggered a manual password reset from the admin console and the customer could sign in again.

precedents.subject: Passwort zurücksetzen funktioniert nicht
precedents.answer_snippet: Der Link zum Zurücksetzen lag im Spam-Ordner. Nach dem Verschieben in den Posteingang konnte der Kunde das Passwort ändern.

draft.text:
Hello,

Thanks for reaching out. Reset emails can take up to 10 minutes to arrive and are often filtered as spam, so please check your spam or junk folder first [TKT-01842]. If nothing arrives, reply to this ticket and we will start a manual reset after verifying your account [TKT-03317].

Best regards,
Support Team
